content: The Central Library of Shaheed Benazir Bhutto Women University was established in 2006 and moved to its purpose-built building in 2014. It supports academic and research needs with over 13,000 volumes including books, journals, magazines, theses, and research papers.
The library provides Web OPAC for online catalog search and access to HEC Digital Library resources for students and faculty.
Library sections include Acquisition, Reading Room, Circulation, Reference & Journals, Research and IT Lab, Eleanor Roosevelt Corner, and Technical Services.
Books are organized using the Dewey Decimal Classification system, where each item is assigned a unique call number based on its subject to help locate it on shelves.
Library services include borrowing books, reference assistance, and reader advisory support to help users access and utilize library resources effectively.
Library operates Monday to Friday from 08:30 AM to 03:15 PM. Circulation timing is from 09:30 AM to 02:00 PM. The library remains closed on public holidays.
Library rules include maintaining silence, no eating or drinking, proper handling of books, returning materials on time, and reporting lost library cards immediately.
Library contact information: Email librarian@sbbwu.edu.pk and phone +92-91-9224749 for inquiries and support.
Central Library staff includes Deputy Librarian Ms. Haseeba Shafi, Library Assistant Ms. Mohsina, Senior Clerks Ms. Bibi Saleema, Ms. Shakila Khan, Ms. Nida Zahid, and support staff Mr. Ashfaq.
